businesses.business: road building and aggregate processing equipment manufacturing

offering_description.value: Designs and manufactures equipment for road building, aggregate crushing and screening, asphalt plants, and related infrastructure work, plus specialty equipment such as horizontal directional drills and wood processing machines. Sells mainly to contractors, quarry and mining operators and government agencies through dealers and direct sales. Also supplies replacement parts.

primary_products.value: asphalt plants; aggregate crushing and screening equipment; pavers and road-building machines; horizontal directional drills; wood chippers and grinders; replacement parts

customer_segment.value: B2B: road contractors, quarries, aggregate producers, mining operators, utility and tree-care contractors; B2G: government agencies and municipalities buying road maintenance and infrastructure equipment

end_markets.value: road construction; infrastructure; aggregates and mining; utilities; forestry and biomass

revenue_model.value: product sales: new equipment sold to contractors and producers, plus replacement parts

value_chain_position.value: OEM / manufacturer: builds heavy equipment from purchased steel and components, sold to contractors, producers and dealers

geography_served.value: global: North America primarily, plus Europe, Latin America, Middle East, Africa, Asia and Australia

specialization.value: related lines: infrastructure equipment: asphalt, aggregate processing, road building, underground drilling and wood processing

distribution_channels.value: distributors / dealers: independent dealer network for equipment and parts; direct sales: sales to large contractors, quarry operators and government customers

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: equipment emissions and safety standards such as EPA engine rules and OSHA, trade and tariff rules
